entities.summary:
Frank Leo Mason III is an American professional basketball player for Limoges CSP of the LNB Pro A. He played college basketball for the University of Kansas, where he was the starting point guard for the Jayhawks. For the 2016–17 season, he was the consensus National Player of the Year
 He was also a consensus All-American selection for his senior season at Kansas.
